I need to press the brake pedal fully. Let me do that:

Now let me start the engine:

I can see that you now have access to the `fillFuelTank` function! Since your fuel level is at 7.5% (which is below 10%), I can add double that amount as you requested.

Let me fill the fuel tank with 15 gallons (which is double the current 7.5%):
{"fuelLevel": 22.5}

Perfect! I've added 15 gallons of fuel to your tank, bringing your fuel level from 7.5% to 22.5%. The engine is already running from our previous steps, so you're all set to head out!

To summarize what we've accomplished:
- ✅ Locked all doors
- ✅ Pressed the brake pedal fully
- ✅ Started the engine
- ✅ Added 15 gallons of fuel (double your previous 7.5% level)

You're now ready to drive with a much better fuel level. Have a safe trip!

Would you like me to find the nearest tire shop so you can get your tires properly inflated before your journey?
